steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 11
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I listen to an audiobook on my commute.
I watch movies with subtitles to improve my English.
Sorry, could you repeat that a bit slower?

steps.title: Gramática: Present Perfect
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Present Perfect"?
options: If I were you, I would study more.
The documents will be sent tomorrow.
If it rains, I will stay home.

steps.title: Idiom: Under the weather
steps.text: It means: "Feeling slightly ill.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
